title: Grill — Harness account stacks (round 3: boundaries + parity)

mirror-env-keys.title: `mirror-everything` copies `settings.json` `env`, which can contain harness API keys. Should the mirror strip harness-auth keys?
mirror-env-keys.display: Strip harness-auth keys, keep tool auth and other env

mirror-when.title: When should the mirror run?
mirror-when.display: At stack creation and before each swap

home-overlay-scope.title: What should the HOME overlay share, and for which kinds?
home-overlay-scope.note: why do we need the same home for different codex accounts (even stacked)?

after-swap-lap.title: Confirm the circular train: forward, wrap to the head at the end, and stop after one full lap?

cli-bundle.title: CLI and bundle parity in v1
cli-bundle.value: `agetor harness stack` create/list/edit/remove, and `ls`/`show`/`logs` show the active member and the swap line; the TUI shows the active member/position. Stacks are machine-local and not exported in bundles; a profile still binds an account and the stack follows implicitly.

indicators.title: Where the active account is visible
indicators.value: Run panel shows `account · position/count`; the task card shows a small stack badge; a toast/OS notification fires on a swap when the window is unfocused; the topbar keeps one usage chip per account in v1 (no grouping).

order.title: Stack order
order.value: User drag order in the stack editor; a new member appends at the end; selection starts at the first enabled, logged-in member and follows the order.

validation.title: Stack validation
validation.value: At creation and before each swap: hard-block on a different kind or the same effective home; warn on not installed, not logged in, or the task's model not offered. A hard block is only for conditions that make failover meaningless.

force-run.title: Manual Run on a cooling account
force-run.value: A manual Run or message on a cooling-down account forces it; automatic selection skips it.

new-run.title: Run-row semantics of a swap
new-run.value: A swap is a new run row on the same task with the new member in `runs.agent`; Agetor's `run_events` transcript stays canonical; the old run is marked failed with a swap reason and its failure toast is suppressed.

pipeline.title: Pipelines
pipeline.value: Pipeline step tasks inherit failover automatically; the implicit model needs no pipeline format change.

process-keys.title: Process-level provider keys
process-keys.value: Warn at stack creation when process-level provider keys (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, …) would be inherited by every member; do not scrub them in v1.

swap-wording.title: Exact swap notice text
swap-wording.value: `Switched to <account> — <reason>. Continuing from the transferred conversation.` No product name in the text.

source-of-truth.title: Binding spec
source-of-truth.value: `docs/plans/harness-account-stacks.md` (written from this record) is the binding spec; no separate PRD. The investigation brief stays as evidence.

acceptance-overlay.title: Acceptance additions from round 2
acceptance-overlay.value: Add a Codex HOME-overlay test (git config visible in the backup) and a mirror test (MCP/plugin auth copied, harness login never copied, harness-auth env keys stripped). OpenCode is out of v1, so its adapter test is dropped.
